Deductible Calculations When 25% At Fault
Section 7 Collision Deductible
When you are partially at fault, your Section 7 Collision deductible is calculated by **multiplying your full Collision deductible by the percentage to which you were at fault**.
Direct Compensation – Property Damage (DC-PD) Deductible

The DC-PD deductible works in the **opposite direction** — it is calculated by multiplying the deductible shown on your Certificate of Automobile Insurance by the percentage to which you were **not** at fault.
